greeting: Hi! I'm Mrs.D, AI Admission Counsellor of Narayana Junior College. How may I help you today?

knowledge.content: Admissions are open for 2026 academic year. Students can apply for MPC, BiPC, and MEC streams.
We offer MPC (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry), BiPC (Biology, Physics, Chemistry), and MEC (Mathematics, Economics, Civics) streams with 120 seats each.
Tuition fee is ₹85,000 per year. Hostel fee is ₹80,000 per year. Transport fee is ₹25,000 per year.
We offer merit scholarships for students scoring above 90% in 10th grade. Special scholarship available for girl students.
Hostel facility available with separate buildings for boys and girls. Hostel closes at 8PM. Mess provides nutritious food.
Transport facility available across the city with GPS-enabled buses. Bus routes cover all major areas.
Highly qualified faculty with IIT and NIT background. Special coaching for EAMCET and JEE.
State-of-the-art laboratories, digital classrooms, library with 10,000+ books, and sports facilities.
Located at Main Road, Hyderabad. Contact number: 040-12345678. Email: admissions@narayana.edu
College timings: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Office hours: 9 AM to 5 PM on weekdays.
